Settings

Gameplay

The original game's rules: its speed table and 4 angles, flat-topped bat, original power-ups and lasers.

New: zones widest just off centre and narrower toward the edges, with a tight straight-up centre. Off = classic equal-width zones.

Fast flicks move the bat further; small movements stay precise.

Visuals

Sounds

Load WAV, MP3 or OGG files named like the sound pack: sfx_01 to sfx_18, intro, jingle. Several files for one sound (sfx_03a, sfx_03b...) are played as random variations.

    Levels

    Load your Arkanoid, Revenge of Doh, Amegas and Crystal Hammer disks (.adf) to carry on with their rounds after Giganoid's 50.
